page0.text:
"Fine. If you wanna settle things now, then let's go. I can't believe you came to school without your Servant—"
"Sorry! I'm begging you, Tohsaka, give me your advice!"
I close in Tohsaka until I've got her backed up against a wall.
Given the subject matter, I can't let the students around us hear.

page1.text: "H-hold on, what are you thinking!? I was just putting you on, but there's a lot of people still around!"

page2.text:
"Please! You're the only one I can count on. I don't know how to stop her from getting sucked into the Holy Grail War. You know a lot of stuff, so can you think of a way to protect her!?"
...

page3.text:
Tohsaka stares at me for a moment, flabbergasted.
"Ah... S-sorry. You had such perfect timing, I lost my cool.
Right, um, so Sakura's this first-year I know, and I feel like she's going to get mixed up in the Holy Grail War. I want to do something about that, but I don't have any good ideas, and—"

page4.text:
"I don't need your excuses. Do you mind backing up now?
Homeroom's about to start."
"...! M-my bad, I didn't realize!"

page5.text:
I scramble back from Tohsaka.
...Belatedly, I come to my senses while my cheeks go beet red.
What was I thinking, cornering her against a wall like that!?

page6.text:
"...I'm sorry. I know it's really pushing it, but hear me out. I—"
"You need advice, right? Fine, I'll listen."
"Eh? R-really, Tohsaka!?"

page7.text:
"...Did you really expect me to say no when you were making a face like you'd die if I turned you down? The roof, at lunchtime. We'll talk then."
Tohsaka turns on her heel and goes up the stairs.

page8.text:
I stare after her in shock for a moment, when,
"Hey, stupid. You'll be late if you don't get going."
she leaves me with those words, in a vaguely pouting tone.
